author: ECON
$comment: Wokwi circuit for the ECON edge node. Pins match src/main.cpp exactly -- change one
here and you must change it there. Build the firmware with:
PLATFORMIO_BUILD_FLAGS='-DUSE_DHT=1 -DUSE_MMWAVE=1 -DUSE_SUPPLY_TEMP=1 -DUSE_PLUG=1' pio run
That flag set is deliberate: it is the largest subset of the node whose every sensor
has a STOCK Wokwi part, so the real firmware runs unmodified with nothing stubbed.
Substitutions and why they are faithful:
DHT22        stands in for the SHT30. USE_DHT is a real firmware path, not a stub --
the SHT30 is not a Wokwi part, and DHT22 is the documented fallback.
Pushbutton   stands in for the Rd-03 mmWave on GPIO18. The firmware only ever reads
that pin as a digital level ('output high when sensing'), so a button
is not an approximation of the contract, it IS the contract.
Potentiometer stands in for the SCT-013 on GPIO34. readPlugAmps() true-RMS samples
the ADC over ~100 ms; a pot gives a real, settable ADC level. It reads
as DC so RMS-of-AC behaviour is not reproduced -- see the caveat below.
DS18B20      is the ACTUAL part, not a substitute.
Relays       are the actual lighting (GPIO23) and plug (GPIO25) modules.
NOT modelled here, because Wokwi has no stock part: SHT30 (I2C), ACD1200 CO2 (I2C),
BH1750 lux (I2C), the IR emitter on GPIO19, and the PZEM-004T (UART). Those need the
Wokwi Custom Chips C API. Leave their build flags OFF and the firmware omits the
fields, which is the correct behaviour and is itself worth testing.
